changelog:
- Initial release of "programming-as-theory-building" skill encapsulating Peter Naur's theory-driven programming principles.
- Provides step-by-step workflow for mapping real-world needs into code changes, emphasizing the preservation and rebuilding of program theory.
- Includes before-coding questions, guidance on surgical changes, boundary establishment, and verification protocols.
- Explicitly discourages speculative abstractions and unfounded flexibility.
- Outlines practical review checklists and structured response shapes to support effective code review and maintenance.
summary: Use when writing, generating, modifying, debugging, reviewing, or refactoring code. Treat code work as rebuilding and preserving the program theory: how real...
